svg.text: What was announced, and what was ever established

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Six claims that shaped the public memory of the Arafat family finances.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: AS IT CIRCULATED

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Suha Arafat was investigated for money

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: laundering in France

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Preliminary inquiry opened Oct 2003. French officials stated

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: the illicit-origin threshold was not met. No formal

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: investigation, no charge, no public disposition, ever.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: She lived on an entire floor of a

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: five-star Paris hotel

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: The hotel said she had never stayed there. The denial was

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: published. The claim continued to circulate unchanged.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: She received $100,000 a month from

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Palestinian funds

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: No bank record, transfer instruction, budget line or named

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: source has been produced in twenty-two years.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Zahwa Arafat is worth $8 billion and

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: owns London property

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: No filing, registry entry, audit or court record exists. The

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: same post places her in Paris; she has lived in Malta since

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: childhood.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: She was subject to a Tunisian arrest

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: warrant

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Correct. Issued Oct 2011 over a private school venture with

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: the Ben Ali family's circle — a Tunisian commercial matter,

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: not Palestinian public money.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: $900 million of Palestinian revenue was

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: diverted, 1995–2000

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Correct, per the IMF. Into an account controlled by Yasser

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Arafat. Most of the traced portion was recovered under Salam

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Fayyad's reforms.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: UNEVIDENCED OR CONTRADICTED

svg.text: DOCUMENTED

svg.text: Sources: Paris prosecutor statements 2003–04; IMF, Sept 2003; Tunisian Justice Ministry, Oct 2011; wire reporting.
